## Overview
Danilo Damiani is a professional Video Editor and Motion Designer with over 5 years of experience specializing in high-impact visual storytelling, SaaS explainer videos, B2B product demos, high-retention YouTube long-form content, and vertical short-form reels.

## Core Specializations & Services
- **SaaS Motion Design & Explainer Videos**: Reconstructing user interfaces from scratch, animating UI flows, 2.5D/3D integration, vector transitions, kinetic typography, and sound design in Adobe After Effects.
- **Strategic Video Editing**: Narrative pacing, retention-focused cuts, b-roll layering, audio mastering, and color grading in Adobe Premiere Pro.
- **High-Retention YouTube Content**: Long-form edits optimized for viewer watch time, engagement, and click-through rates.
- **Short-Form Vertical Videos**: High-converting Reels, TikToks, and Shorts for brands, finance, real estate, and digital products.

## Featured Projects & Case Studies
- **Shipper.now Promo Video**:
  - *Context*: Motion design contest submission selected among the best on X (April 2026).
  - *Creative Execution*: Built from scratch starting with storyboarding, animating custom UI elements and logos, integrating 3D models, and sound design in After Effects.
  - *Category*: SaaS Motion Explainer.
- **Howly.io Hero Video**:
  - *Context*: Above-the-fold hero animation for on-demand expert consultation platform.
  - *Creative Execution*: Recreated every single interface element from scratch and animated smoothly in After Effects to demonstrate the frictionless user flow.
  - *Category*: Website Animation from Scratch.
- **Real Estate Premium Vlog**: Cinematic light editing, visual polish, and luxury pacing.
- **Premium Faceless Editing**: High-retention narrative structuring, graphics, and visual hooks.
- **Documentary & Narrative Edit**: Story-driven documentary editing with dynamic archival and motion assets.

## Technical Skills & Tooling
- **Primary Software**: Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro.
- **Techniques**: UI/UX Animation, 2.5D Camera Tracking, Kinetic Typography, Sound FX Design, Color Correction, Dynamic Pacing, Lightweight Web Asset Delivery.
